architecture.label: Static allowlisted SQL generator
architecture.copy: This Pages demo does not execute arbitrary SQL. It renders checked-in Open Data Duck recipes generated from the registry so visitors can try the workflow without turning GitHub Pages into an open compute proxy. Browser-side DuckDB-Wasm is the next execution path for CORS-friendly recipes; Worker execution is deferred until DuckDB packaging, CPU, memory, and sandboxing limits are proven.

examples.title: Overture places near Alaska
examples.description: Generate the direct DuckDB httpfs recipe for Overture Maps public S3 release files with a small bounding-box filter.
examples.result_note: Generated SQL output only. It is not executed in the browser because public S3 reads still depend on browser CORS and memory limits.

examples.title: Census county boundary files
examples.description: Generate the DuckDB spatial recipe for official Census cartographic county shapefiles over HTTPS.
examples.result_note: Generated SQL output only. The spatial extension and GDAL virtual file path run in DuckDB, not on this static page.

examples.title: NOAA daily climate CSV
examples.description: Generate a DuckDB httpfs recipe for NOAA GHCN Daily observations stored as public S3 CSV files.
examples.result_note: Generated SQL output only. This keeps the public demo bounded while still showing real Open Data Duck output.
